title: Here's What I'm Planning With My Eli Lilly Position
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA checks his Eli Lilly position: revenue has more than doubled since 2023 to $79.7 billion on weight-loss injectables, the pill version is gaining adoption, operating margin is 49.7% with gross margin above 80%, and ROIC recently near 40% is about four times WACC. At a forward P/E of 26 and his updated DCF of $1,523 against $1,251, he sees more than 20% upside over 12-18 months. He reiterates BUY with relatively high conviction and wants to add rather than take profits; US drug-price pressure is the named headwind. Videos first seen as members-only and later public, hence analyzed in this run.

calls.video_title: Here's What I'm Planning With My Eli Lilly Position
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated, relatively high conviction (was BUY 2026-09-28; no flip): he bought a few months ago, is not taking profits and wants to add. Forward P/E 26 is attractive for the characteristics; DCF $1,523 vs $1,251 implies >20% upside over 12-18 months at relatively lower risk.
calls.base_case: Revenue has more than doubled since 2023 to $79.7B on injectable weight-loss drugs, with the new pill version gaining adoption and more pipeline behind it; operating margin 49.7% and gross margin above 80%.
calls.bull_case: Earnings and profits keep growing faster than the share price, so the value improves even as the price rises; ROIC recently near 40%, about 4x WACC, shows the R&D pays.
calls.bear_case: US administration pressure to cut drug prices is the live headwind — still too early to know whether it is words or tangible action.
